Type: wall-mounted storage cabinet
Use: storing small items on a wall; living room, entryway, home office
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: distressed solid wood, black metal handles
Colors: warm natural brown wood, black
Shape: shallow wall cabinet, three open cubbies on top, two barn doors with X-brace panels, arched handles, compact
Feel: rustic, warm, homey
Goes with: white shiplap, black iron, galvanized metal, cream textiles; farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Farmhouse Wall Mounted Cabinet Storage Organzier - 23 x19 x 6 Inch, Natural Wood
product.description: This wall cabinet provides vintage style along with storage space for spices, mail and more in your kitchen or entryway. Display small objects or stash your keys in the three cubbies on the bottom. The distressed finish adds to the antique appeal. 19.25" W x 23.25" H x 6.75" D Constructed from hardwood; iron hinges and door pulls Ready to hang, all hardware included
